Name: Better Crab Pot
Author: po0pfart
Description:
This mod allows you to configure crab pot and fish catch rate, junk items and bait behavior. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url] for full configuration of the mod.

[size=3][b]Bait settings:[/b][/size]
The chance of getting junk item for regular bait is 20%, while wild bait and deluxe bait is 10%. The junk multiplier number simply multiply the chances.

[size=3][b]Deluxe bait quality settings:[/b][/size]
Adjust the chance of getting gold and iridium catch.

[b][size=3]Wild bait settings:[/size][/b]
Adjust the minimum and maximum quantity of catch using wild bait.

[b][size=3]Junk item settings:[/size][/b]
Adjust the junk items catch rate. This only works when junk chance is higher than 0.

[size=3][b]Crab pot settings:[/b][/size]
Adjust the crab pot fish catch rate, both freshwater and ocean type. This won't work if junk chance is 100%.

[b][size=3]Location fish settings:[/size][/b]
Adjust the fish catch rate on every location. This won't work if junk chance is 100%

[b][size=3]Catch mode and trap fish weight:[/size][/b]
Choose if you want to catch just trap, or fish, or both. When catch mode is both, you can control how many percent trap fish have in the combined catch.
